name: Anthropic model launch
title: We've launched Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5)
summary: Claude Opus 5 is our new language model for complex reasoning.

name: Anthropic managed agent budget
title: You can now set a budget on a Claude Managed Agents session
summary: The budget is a hard cap on session spend at public list rates.

name: Anthropic GET endpoint
title: The GET /v1/environments/{id}/work endpoint is now available
summary: It lists pending work for a self-hosted sandbox on Claude Platform.

name: Anthropic tokenizer update
title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 use a new tokenizer
summary: The tokenizer changes token counts compared with Claude Opus 4.7.

name: Anthropic feature on existing model
title: We've launched task budgets in beta on Claude Opus 4.7
summary: The budget parameter controls a full agentic loop.

name: xAI model launch
title: Grok 4.6
summary: Grok 4.6, xAI's frontier model for coding, is now available on the xAI API.

name: xAI tools GA
title: Tools are now generally available
summary: The search and code execution tools have graduated from beta on the xAI API.

name: xAI API public beta
title: Files API public beta
summary: The Files API endpoint is now available to developers.

name: product launch mentioning explicit model id
title: Prompt caching and Batch API launch
summary: We launched prompt caching and the Batch API for Model: gpt-5.7-preview.

name: Google image-only family
title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image is generally available
summary: gemini-3.1-flash-image is our native visual image model for image generation.

name: Google video-generation multimodal family
title: Gemini Omni Flash in public preview
summary: We launched a multimodal model for video generation from text descriptions and visual prompts.

name: Google display-name image family
title: Launched Nano Banana 2, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview
summary: A high-efficiency model optimized for high-volume visual creation.

name: Google audio-to-audio family
title: Released gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview
summary: The latest audio-to-audio model for real-time dialogue and voice-first applications.

name: Google native audio output family
title: Released gemini-2.5-flash-preview-native-audio-dialog
summary: A new Gemini model with native audio output capabilities.

name: text-capable multimodal model launch
title: Introducing Gemini 4 Pro
summary: Gemini 4 Pro is a vision-language model accepting image input and returning text.

name: uncertain model article
title: Gemini 4 model preview update
summary: The model is being evaluated with selected developers; no launch was announced.

name: model deprecation
title: We announced the deprecation of Claude Sonnet 4
summary: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 will be retired next month.

name: feature support on an existing model
title: Grounding with Maps is now supported for Gemini 3 models
summary: The feature will be enabled going forward.

name: model alias redirect
title: Changed the latest Gemini aliases
summary: gemini-pro-latest now redirects to gemini-3-pro-preview.

name: Qwen reinforcement learning method paper
title: SAPO: A Stable Reinforcement Learning Method
summary: A research method for training large language models.

name: Qwen embedding and reranking model
title: Qwen3 Embedding
summary: We release Qwen3 Embedding, a new model for text embedding, retrieval, and reranking.

name: Qwen drawing model
title: Introducing Qwen VLo
summary: A native visual model for drawing and image output.

name: Qwen text-output omni model
title: Introducing Qwen3-Omni
summary: A vision-language model that accepts text, images, audio, and video and returns text.
